CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Storytelling and Animation: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Storytelling and Animation.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Storytelling and Animation.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Storytelling and Animation.
   D. Practise Storytelling and Animation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. Best practice when working on Javelin and Sculpture: (1 mark)
